recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if FHIR-I makes a new explicit ordering decision for `then` group invocations; the repeated-invocation syntax itself is correctly represented.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-I change request noting that StructureMap.group.rule.dependent is 0..* but the mapping language and grammar did not clearly show repeated dependent group invocations, requesting comma-separated invocations after `then`.
initial_application: FHIR-20840 was applied together with FHIR-20848 by commits 562bf9f82d7 and a81d5848a6, merged by PR #984 as b3a5ebd9c3. The application added comma-separated multiple-group wording to source/mapping-language.html and repeated invocation grammar to images/mapping.g4. The 2025 grammar refactor db673c36e8 preserved repeated groupInvocation syntax.
additional_context: This issue is the same change family as the seed and required no separate search path. StructureMap remains active in source/fhir.ini, and the mapping-language page plus linked grammar are in current build scope. Later FHIR-25220/FHIR-23010 evidence explains why deterministic execution-order prose should not be added as part of this audit.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current spec already documents and parses repeated comma-separated dependent group invocations, and the active StructureMap model still has dependent at 0..*.

related_jiras.note: Same resolution and application commits, adding optional nested dependent rules after the invocation list.
Later clarification about multiple group invocations and disputed execution-order wording.
Current mapping-language guidance says rules may be applied in any order and order is implementation-defined.
